name: Category Briefing
description: A CrewAI crew (researcher, then editor) that reads the market this week: what enterprise buyers are reacting to in the market category you name (cloud data warehouses, observability, ...), or by default in AI cost, agent governance and software security. Five sourced items from the last seven days, each with headline, source, date and URL, plus the one item that should change a renewal conversation. The market, not a named account: it does not research one company, GitHub or a contract. It uses only the search tools granted to it and refuses rather than answer from memory.
